title: Luminaide Systems
text:
Luminaide Systems

product_fit_summary:
Highly aligned: extension needs streaming responses, model pinning, routing by cost tiers, and per-seat quotas. Prefers Redwood's Optimize suggestions for batching/quantization recommendations. Interested in Dedicated for predictable throughput if POC meets latency/cost goals.

next_step:
Kickoff 2-week POC for VS Code streaming completions; deliver latency report + token-cost estimate

blockers:
security SOC2/KMS Qs not yet answered
clarify per-seat rate-limit model
demo license for enterprise features

poc_details:
2-week POC scope: integrate Redwood hosted API into internal VS Code extension prototype. Deliverables: 1) streaming websocket integration with prefix caching; 2) latency/throughput report; 3) token cost model by usage pattern; 4) guidance config for model pinning and fallback. Success metrics: median suggestion latency <= 100ms, stable UI streaming with <1% glitch rate.

notes:
Quick notes from AE/SE pipeline. Target: VS Code extension copilot (first-party extension for enterprise dev teams). Wants streaming low-latency completions with inline suggestions and per-seat rate limits. Emphasis on model pinning/rollouts: need ability to pin to a specific model family + patch-level pin for canaries. Cost sensitivity: aggressive token budgets for OSS customers — wants Optimize recommendations.

On calls: "I've seen big regressions when model switches mid-deploy" — engineering lead. Concerned about auth + quota enforcement across Org seats (SSO + seat provisioning). Also flagged offline fallback: local snippet cache + graceful degrade when service rate-limited.

SE notes: initial latency SLO target 50-100ms median for local suggestions, 95th <300ms for full completions. Throughput: 800 concurrent active developers across teams, bursty commit times. POC asks: instrument streaming websocket demo and show token-cost per suggestion.

Meeting stubs: security review requested Drive FAQ, provided SOC2 artifact stub. Jira for client encryption/KMS follow-up.
